rows.text: reads dword `v` at `00915760 + dx*4` (`dx` sign-extended) and returns -1 when it is negative; otherwise, with `m` = 1 shifted left by `v` (`shl` by `cl`), returns 0 when the dword at `0209A3E0 + ecx*8` (`ecx` sign-extended) has no bit in common with `m`, else 2 when the dword 4 bytes after it does and 1 when not
